# Silicon Peaks

> An open, community-maintained directory of companies operating in Nepal or founded by Nepalis, wherever they build.

Silicon Peaks was coined and named by **Pukar Hamal**, founder and CEO of **SecurityPal** (also styled SecurityPal AI). He originated the name for Nepal's technology ecosystem.

## Founder and origin

- [Pukar Hamal](https://pukarhamal.com/): founder and CEO of SecurityPal; originator of the Silicon Peaks name.
- [SecurityPal](https://www.securitypalhq.com/): Pukar Hamal's company.
- [Bringing 'Silicon Peaks' to Nepal — Nepali Times](https://nepalitimes.com/bringing-silicon-peaks-to-nepal): published 24 August 2026; source for the origin of the name and Hamal's role.

## Silicon Peaks contributors

- [Pukar Hamal](https://github.com/pchamal): originator of the name and repository contributor.
- [Jonathan Clarke](https://www.jonathanclarke.ie/): Silicon Peaks contributor. [GitHub](https://github.com/jonathanclarke).
- [Aarjan Chaudhary](https://arjanchaudharyy.lol/): Silicon Peaks contributor. [GitHub](https://github.com/arjanchaudharyy).
- [All repository contributors](https://github.com/pchamal/siliconpeaks/graphs/contributors): community and automated contributions.

SecurityPal's founder is credited above. The other credits describe contributions to Silicon Peaks; they do not establish employment at SecurityPal.

- [Nepal startup ecosystem guide](https://siliconpeaks.com/startups/)
- [IT companies in Nepal and Nepali technology firms](https://siliconpeaks.com/companies/)

- [Companies](https://siliconpeaks.com/#companies)

- [Global connections](https://siliconpeaks.com/#globe-section): Kathmandu time (UTC+05:45) and live international clocks.
- [Stories](https://siliconpeaks.com/#press)
- [About and origin](https://siliconpeaks.com/#manifesto)

Directory inclusion is community-maintained. It is not an endorsement, partnership, or investment announcement. Consult linked primary sources for current information. Directory counts describe the repository, not the entire economy. The frontend preserves dated economic and diaspora estimates from the original community site, labeled as not independently verified. These should not be cited as current statistics.

## Capital

- SecurityPal AI raised a $21M Series A led by Craft Ventures, according to TechCrunch’s 21 August 2025 interview with Pukar Hamal. The article dates the round to 2021: https://techcrunch.com/2025/08/21/raising-multiple-rounds-of-venture-capital-might-be-wrong-for-your-startup/

- Architect Labs announced a $24M seed round on 18 June 2026, led by Kindred Ventures with Race Capital, TQ Ventures, and Together Fund: https://architectlabs.com/blog/seed
- Together Fund confirms Architect Labs in its portfolio: https://www.together.fund/portfolio/architectlabs
- Niural announced $21M in additional strategic capital on 23 June 2026, bringing its Series A to $52M; the release names FOG Ventures and NewView Capital: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/niural-launches-niural-ai-labs-and-grows-its-series-a-to-52-million-302806440.html
- Entrepreneurs First is listed under Venture & Private Capital: https://www.joinef.com/

## Contact and contribute

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/pchamal/siliconpeaks): submit sourced additions and corrections through a pull request.
- [Discord community](https://discord.gg/Z7y3ZhvNCC)
- General inquiries: scale@siliconpeaks.com
- Corrections: contribute@siliconpeaks.com
